title: Intracranial entrainment reveals statistical learning across levels of abstraction (Sherman et al., 2023): raw iEEG from 8 neurosurgical patients
description: Raw intracranial EEG (iEEG) recordings from 8 neurosurgical patients with electrodes implanted for seizure monitoring. Patients passively viewed rapid streams of scene photographs containing statistical regularities at the category or exemplar level, and neural entrainment (phase coherence) was measured at the image (2 Hz) and pair (1 Hz) frequencies. The data support analysis of online statistical learning across levels of abstraction and are provided in iEEG-BIDS format with MNI electrode coordinates.
methods_description: Patients viewed streams of outdoor scene images (250 ms image, 250 ms ISI) in category-level structured, exemplar-level structured, and random conditions, presented with MATLAB and the Psychophysics Toolbox. iEEG was recorded with a Natus NeuroWorks system at 4096 Hz, with 8-bit triggers inserted into an open EEG channel. Electrodes were localized using post-operative CT and MRI and registered to MNI space.
